# A line on the top copper, a via, and a line on the bottom copper: each of the via's pins joins the same-layer
# line end on its net, at the barrel's centre, and the second line carries straight on.
# The run's ground pours are plain rectangles that clear only vias passing through them: the bottom pour (TL1's
# ground) runs under TL2 and the via's bottom pad, and the top pour (TL2's ground) runs under TL1 and the via's top pad.
# The overlap check reports all four, the via once for each pour, which is what it is for; the pour planner clearing signal copper on its own layer is not this
# design's to fix.
